title: A new way to look at the night sky starts with a little curiosity
summary: Space exploration can feel distant. Public mission archives offer a closer look at the questions that keep us looking up.
meta_description: Space exploration can feel distant. Public mission archives offer a closer look at the questions that keep us looking up.
author: The Current Editorial Desk
paragraphs: Space science begins with questions about the universe and our place in it. Public mission pages offer a starting point for exploring how researchers observe planets, stars and distant galaxies.

This demonstration article shows where an editor would explain a development, identify its source and describe what remains uncertain. It is an evergreen layout example, not a report about a new mission.

For real reporting, follow the source link and check the mission page directly. A published story should distinguish an observation from an interpretation and clearly identify the date of any announcement.
